contentText: François Picard is pleased to welcome Israeli writer and filmmaker Etgar Keret, author of "The Seven Good Years", joining us from Tel Aviv. Keret argues that Netanyahu is seeking to remain in power, at any cost, including delegitimizing Arab parties and prolonging conflict. “For him, it could be a never-ending war as long as he's in power. He has no incentive to stop it,” he warns. Keret also calls for Israelis to examine how the war in Gaza was conducted, arguing that “the media as a whole ignored the war.”
